_meta.purpose: What is on each building's ground floor, as a programme the explorer turns into a MOCK-UP ground-floor plan (parametric/mvk/ground.py): every space below becomes a tenancy with its own street door, sized by its share of the floor, around the building's core and back of house.
_meta.status: MOCK-UP plans. WHICH activity is in which building is read from the sources below; WHERE in the building it sits, its size and its layout are invented for discussion. Replace with surveyed plans or the rent roll when they arrive; keep the same shape.
_meta.sources: OpenStreetMap via Nominatim (data/projects/marievik/urban_life.json, amenities - each point tested against the OSM footprints of parametric/site/marievik_site.json), AMF's events timeline (same file), the building names in the site file (SATS, Nordic Wellness, H&M ...), and 'mock-up' where nothing is known.
_meta.supermarkets: No supermarket stands in any of the 13 modelled buildings. The nearest are ICA Supermarket at Sjövikstorget (about 80 m from B13) and Lidl, ICA Kvantum, Coop and Willys at Liljeholmstorget (about 240-320 m from B08). None is added here.
_meta.kinds: supermarket | restaurant | cafe | gym | event | shop | lobby | bike. 'share' = share of the floor left once the core and back of house are taken out; the spaces are laid out in this order along the building's long axis.

B01.note: B01 already has a drawn ground floor (data/plans/marievik/B01.json: café, lobby, reception, services) - it keeps that plan.
